_comment: M1 target sites (issue #3 Q1, issue #16). Pages are not committed: `cargo xtask snapshots` downloads each pinned resource from its archived source into target/snapshots/<site>/<sha256>; `cargo xtask snapshots --discover [site]` re-pins a site from the web archive at its timestamp. `cargo xtask sites` renders each site at width x height CSS px and compares it with conformance/sites/reference/<site>.png.
